subject: Upcoming Company Event: Save the Date!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual company-wide event will be held on Friday, December 10th. Join us for a fun-filled day of team-building activities, delicious food, and exciting prizes. More details and the official invitation will be sent out soon. Please mark your calendars and save the date! We look forward to celebrating together as a team. Best regards, [Your Name]
